sql:
WITH family_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        family_label, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT listing_key) AS open_remote_listings
    FROM fct_posting
    WHERE is_open = true AND remote_us = true
    GROUP BY family_label
)
SELECT 
    family_label,
    open_remote_listings,
    CAST(open_remote_listings AS DOUBLE) / SUM(open_remote_listings) OVER () AS share
FROM family_counts
ORDER BY open_remote_listings DESC
